draft.emotion: warm and helpful, ready to provide support to someone in need
notes: Also very commonly conjugated as 'βοηθάω' in everyday speech. Simple past (aorist): 'βοήθησα'.
Takes a direct object in the accusative case for the person helped (e.g. 'Σε βοηθώ' — I help you).

draftBefore.shortGloss: to help; to assist; to make easier
draftBefore.emotion: warm and helpful, ready to provide support to someone in need
notes: Note that this verb is active. When you want to say 'I help myself', you would use the middle-passive form 'βοηθιέμαι'.
